name: funneltrack360-monorepo
description: Multi-tenant SaaS CRM and Business Management Platform (Modular Monolith)

scripts.build: npm run check:no-orm && npm run build --workspace=@ft360/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@ft360/api && npm run build --workspace=@ft360/web
scripts.lint: npm run check:no-orm && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@ft360/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run check:no-orm && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
